info.title: LedgerAPI
info.description: A small expense tracker REST API. Register, get a JWT, then manage your own categories, expenses and monthly budgets and see spending summaries. Click Authorize and paste an access token to try it out.

post.description:
Takes a set of user credentials and returns an access and refresh JSON web
token pair to prove the authentication of those credentials.
post.summary: Log in: get an access and refresh token

post.description:
Takes a refresh type JSON web token and returns an access type JSON web
token if the refresh token is valid.
post.summary: Get a new access token using a refresh token

get.description: Each budget includes how much has been spent in its category, month and currency. Filter with month=YYYY-MM, category and over_budget. Sort with ordering=month, limit or spent (prefix - for descending).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Month as YYYY-MM

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: Which field to use when ordering the results.

parameters.name: over_budget
parameters.description: Only budgets that are (or are not) over the limit

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results to return per page.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: A search term.

post.description:
Limit a view to records owned by the logged-in user.

Every model using this has an `owner` foreign key. Because the queryset is
filtered before DRF looks up a single object, asking for another user's
record gives a 404, exactly as if it did not exist. A 403 would leak
the fact that the id is in use.
post.summary: Create a monthly budget for a category

get.description: Filter with date_after, date_before, category, uncategorized, min_amount, max_amount and currency. Search the description with search=. Sort with ordering=date, -date, amount or -amount. Paginate with page= and page_size= (max 100).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id

parameters.name: date_after
parameters.description: Date range (inclusive)

parameters.name: date_before
parameters.description: Date range (inclusive)

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: Which field to use when ordering the results.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results to return per page.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: A search term.

parameters.name: uncategorized
parameters.description: Only expenses without a category

get.description: Liveness check for load balancers and Docker. Needs no token.

Total spent, totals by category and totals by month for the current user. Dates are inclusive and both are optional. Only one currency is summed at a time, because adding different currencies together would give a meaningless number.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Only expenses in this currency are added up. Defaults to USD.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Last day to include (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: First day to include (YYYY-MM-DD).

spent.description: Total of this category's expenses in this month and currency.

remaining.description: limit minus spent. Negative when over budget.

EmailTokenObtainPairRequest.description: Log in with email + password instead of username + password.
